final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM stats WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
